summary: The candidate is a verified partial diagnostic improvement: it warns at startup about the request-capacity/decode-graph gap, but leaves the 4096-versus-32 mismatch and original eager-decode absorbing-state mechanism intact. Its submitted regression is not a valid clean failing-before test because all three cases raise AttributeError on the recorded base before exercising behavior.

tests.command: /tmp/amdpilot-repo-j-7b5bdd3be71e/venv/bin/python -m pytest -vv /tmp/test_cuda_graph_request_capacity_warning.py --tb=short (candidate test extracted unchanged, run at base)
tests.what_was_measured: Failing-before quality: 3/3 tests failed in helper setup with AttributeError because the new private method did not exist; this contradicts the candidate's recorded 1-failed/2-passed characterization and does not isolate the missing warning behavior.
Exact candidate regression and adjacent configurator coverage: 44 tests and 7 subtests passed.

The candidate still resolved issue defaults to 4096 versus graph max 32 and warned once; equality and DP-scaled equality did not warn; 33 versus 32 warned; disabled/absent graph configs did not warn; a KV cap below 32 did not emit the graph-gap warning.

Exact-candidate source checkout on gfx950 warned for effective capacity 4 versus graph max 2, captured decode batches [1, 2], served four HTTP probes with status 200, and reaped its owned process group.

gpu_execution_evidence: reports/j-7b5bdd3be71e/raw/candidate/server-fixture/server.log records AMD gfx950 startup, the 4-versus-2 warning, and decode graph capture [1, 2]; probe-summary.json records four HTTP 200 responses.
remaining_counterexamples: With token_capacity=3145118, context_len=32768, graph max_bs=32, and default admission, the candidate still returns max_running_requests=4096. A warning does not prevent batches above 32 or their eager fallback.
The candidate makes no scheduler or graph-capacity policy change, so the original L40/Qwen workload can still enter the reported high-latency absorbing state after crossing the graph ceiling.
The unchanged candidate regression cannot distinguish behavioral absence of the warning on base from absence of the newly introduced private helper; all three base cases fail with AttributeError.
remaining_limitations: The assigned GPU was AMD MI350X/gfx950, not NVIDIA L40; the reported CUDA/L40 performance transition was not reproduced.
Qwen/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct weights and ShareGPT workload were unavailable, so the 4x ITL transition and no-recovery dynamics remain unverified in this environment.
The deterministic tiny Llama fixture validates transport and engine execution only, not Qwen architecture, semantic accuracy, full-model performance, or distributed behavior.
No native source changed; no native rebuild was required.
